messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands with its back to the camera, then raises both arms overhead in a V-shape before lowering them back to its sides.","camera":"A static, medium full-body shot from behind the character at a slightly low angle.","clothing":"A black long-sleeved jacket with white trim at the cuffs, black trousers with a white side stripe, a black belt, and brown shoes.","hair_color":"Bright blue.","hairstyle":"Hair is pulled up into a high ponytail.","identity":"A 3D-rendered humanoid character with a slim build, seen from behind.","scene":"An outdoor urban rooftop or plaza with a tiled floor, a metal tower structure on the left, and multi-story buildings with signage in the background under a clear sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a street with trees, a streetlight, and a fence to a tiled rooftop/plaza with a metal tower, speaker, and multi-story buildings matching the reference. The character, blue ponytail, black outfit, arm-raising action, and rear medium full-body framing remain largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Change the scene to the reference rooftop/urban plaza setting while keeping the same person, blue ponytail, black outfit, action, and camera framing, with natural lighting.
uncertain: Whether the character's lighting is fully natural relative to the new scene, since the character appears somewhat uniformly lit.
unexpected_changes: The character's shadow is no longer clearly visible on the ground in the same way as in the source.
